cover.html: Introduce the customer proof of concept. The persona is an email administrator using Cisco Secure Email Gateway. The available dataset is metrics only, so the demo focuses on operational visibility and triage rather than message forensics.
poc-framing.html: Frame the customer challenge. Email is business critical, but administrators often discover delivery issues through tickets. Elastic gives one operational view for gateway health, mail flow, queue pressure, domain delivery, and host status.
scenario-1-delivery-pressure.html: How to present: use this as the lead scenario. Let the animation show signals moving through the Elastic approach block, then name the customer pain: users and helpdesk tickets are a late signal. Explain that Elastic correlates mail flow, queue pressure, SMTP connections, and gateway health so the administrator can narrow the issue before impact becomes visible. After this slide, move into the live dashboard and show health KPIs, received versus delivered rates, queue trend, bounces, and host or destination filters. Full demo script: demo/scenario-1-delivery-pressure.md.
scenario-2-domain-scope.html: How to present: position this as the scoping scenario. Use the animated bars to show domain comparison and highlight the partner domain as the outlier. Explain that a customer may hear that one partner or business domain has delayed mail, but the email team needs to prove whether the issue is internal or domain-specific. In the live demo, filter by destination domain and show delivered recipients, hard bounces, soft bounces, and latest host status. Emphasize that the value is faster ownership and cleaner communication. Full demo script: demo/scenario-2-domain-scope.md.
scenario-3-capacity-pressure.html: How to present: use this scenario when the customer cares about resilience and planning. Use the animated bars to show resource and queue pressure building over time. Explain that a gateway can look available while queues and resource metrics reveal pressure building up. In the live demo, show queue trend, CPU, RAM, disk I/O, system utilization, SMTP connections, and latest host status. Close by tying this to capacity planning and proactive operations. Full demo script: demo/scenario-3-capacity-pressure.md.
closing.html: Close on the customer value. Elastic turns Cisco Secure Email Gateway metrics into a repeatable operations workflow: detect earlier, isolate faster, act with context, and reuse the same view for daily monitoring and capacity planning.
